---
title: "قیدی بنی کھڑی ہے کربل میں زہراؑ ثانی"
alternateTitle: "Qaidi Bani Khari Hai Karbal Mein Zahra Sani"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Qaidi bani khari hai Karbal mein Zahra sani
Bhulegi kaise Zainab, baad az Nabi jo ki hai ummat ne meharbani

1
Zahra bhi dua detin, Maula se ajr milta
Is kaam ke sadqe mein Firdaus mein ghar milta
Karbal mein Musalmano, do ghunt pila dete Asghar ko agar paani

2
Paaband-e-rasan Zainab, chaadar bhi nahi sar pe
Tuti hai qayaamat wo Zahra ke bhare ghar pe
Baazu bandhe hue hain Haider ki betiyon ke, hai Shaam ko rawaani

3
Karbal na gayi Bibi, baithi hai Madine mein
Haaye barchhi lagi kaise tere bhaai ke sine mein
Mar jaayegi Sughra tu, Zainab ne jab sunaayi Akbar ki ye kahaani

4
Qaidi bimaar Sayyid, aankhoṅ se lahu jaari
Zainab ki asiri pe roya hai raat saari
Bhula na marte dam tak, kar kar ke yaad roya Akbar ki naujawaani

5
Maatam namaaz teri, Qaaim namaaz kar lo
Zahra ki duaaon se daaman ko apne bhar lo
Maula ka zikr karna, Zainab ko rona Akhtar momin ki hai nishaani

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/qaidi-bani-khari-hai-karbal-mein-zahra-sani.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
assert roman == old
for edition, digits in ((roman, '12345'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵')):
    blocks = [b.splitlines() for b in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(b) for b in blocks] == [2, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4]
    assert ''.join(b[0] for b in blocks[1:]) == digits
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta and 'noUrdu' not in meta
print('Roman transcription unchanged. Both editions have 17 verses across the preamble and five numbered stanzas.')
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/qaidi-bani-khari-hai-karbal-mein-zahra-sani.md"
